scope: Synthetic stress test, not measured accuracy or real user prevalence. Final adaptive questions replace task slots inside 48, never add questions.
assumptions: Independent fair binary core choices; 14 uniform single-choice tasks; each of the final two slots is either a uniform task choice or a uniform adaptive response.
limitations: Construct coverage and reachability do not establish reliability or validity
32 core items retain eight per axis, with no fabricated answers to omitted items
Role mappings and initial 60/40 weights remain editorial and uncalibrated
